questions.prompt: Before Tycho Brahe's parallax work, Keating says most astronomers thought comets were:
choices: B Atmospheric / nearby phenomena rather than distant solar-system bodies (as his work constrained).
D Purely optical illusions with no path.
questions.explain: Tycho's parallax constraints pushed comets beyond mere local atmosphere ideas.

questions.prompt: Widmanstätten patterns, etched in meteorite slices, indicate for Keating that the object:
choices: A Formed last week in a volcano.
B Has a crystalline structure from slow cooling in a differentiated parent body (not ordinary Earth rock).
C Is pure ice from Antarctica snow.
questions.explain: Those etched crystalline patterns fingerprint certain iron meteorites.

questions.prompt: Keating says Earth's water largely originated from:
choices: B Comets bombarding Earth after the Moon-forming Theia impact.
questions.explain: He ties water delivery to post-Theia cometary bombardment.

questions.prompt: The 1950s lab attempt Keating references to produce amino acids from non-living chemicals is associated with:
choices: B Miller–Urey-style origin-of-life experiments (Darwin's warm pond idea operationalized).
questions.explain: He discusses abiogenesis chemistry attempted in the 1950s.

questions.prompt: Which SETI-related effort does Keating name among well-funded "Breakthrough" projects?
choices: A Breakthrough Listen (large radio telescopes searching for signals).
questions.explain: He highlights Breakthrough Listen (and related breakthrough projects).
